spec_match.rationale: Every panel runs the real surface: strict vs truthy reads of replacedByUserAgent, prototype-member feature gates, the explainer's catch-up pattern, and the explainer's non-goals/anti-fingerprinting guarantees probed against the live objects.

interactive.rationale: Five buttons across four panels each execute the pattern under discussion against this browser and print the actual values observed.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises undefined-vs-false, addEventListener-is-not-a-probe, the missed-event race, and the anti-fingerprinting look; all four panels exist and behave as promised.

edge_cases.rationale: This page is the edge-case portfolio: it also cleans up the expando its own writability test creates so later panels keep reading the honest undefined, and the race panel explains why synthetic dispatch cannot forge the readonly property in either support state.

references.rationale: See-also links the explainer's privacy and non-goals sections plus the chromestatus.com/feature/5076374013476864 entry.

conformance.rationale: The suite's fresh-image-reads-false and readonly-accessor assertions pin the exact contracts panels 1 and 4 teach, and the anti-fingerprinting guarantee is honestly recorded as a manual assertion.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless CDP harness ran all four panels in order plus a re-run of panel 1 after the writability test, verifying the missed-event race, the non-throwing listener attachment, the no-author-trigger sweep, and the expando cleanup; zero console errors; screenshot read and judged.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the strict-check/support agreement, listener-attachment behaviour, the demonstrated race, and the absence of any author-side trigger, each with support-state details.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; verdict panels use emerald/rose accent borders on ivory with charcoal hints on stone, all AA pairs.

accessibility.rationale: All controls are native buttons with focus-visible outlines and specific names, each verdict is a role=status region, and the two-step race panel is an ordered list conveying sequence.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Four panels collapse to a single column at 820px; pre-wrap mono verdicts wrap within the viewport; feature responsive-check recorded desktop clean and mobile 0-overflow with 44px+ buttons.

openQuestions.title: Confirm supported-browser branches of all four panels on a flag-enabled 152 build
openQuestions.detail: Each panel prints a dedicated supported-browser narrative (boolean reads, race catch-up via a real replacement, readonly accessor ignoring/throwing on assignment) that has only executed its unsupported branch here. Re-run the four panels on a build with UAImageReplacementAPI enabled to confirm the supported-path wording matches observed behaviour, especially whether strict-mode assignment to the readonly accessor throws or no-ops.

guidanceConsulted.query: status region per panel results without duplicate announcements
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Give each independently-updating result its own role=status region with a stable location and update it wholesale.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Each panel owns one role=status verdict block replaced atomically per run; no per-line announcements.

guidanceConsulted.query: four panel pattern grid stacking on mobile with long preformatted output
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: minmax(0,1fr) tracks plus white-space pre-wrap and overflow-wrap for long technical output.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Verdicts use pre-wrap + overflow-wrap anywhere inside minmax(0,1fr) panels; 0px horizontal overflow measured at 360px on the feature run.

guidanceConsulted.query: anti-fingerprinting guarantees of user-agent mediated features
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Minimise what sites can learn; never expose capability signals without user action.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Panel 4 demonstrates and explains the explainer's anti-fingerprinting stance instead of attempting to bypass it, and telemetry payloads carry only support-state booleans.

summary: Resilient Adoption executes the four sharp edges of adopting this API against the live browser: undefined-vs-false, non-probing listener attachment, the missed-event race with the readonly catch-up, and the designed absence of any author trigger. CDP verification confirmed every panel's honest unsupported-branch output, the expando cleanup, and a clean console.
